aries.name: Aries
aries.daily: With the Moon activating your sector of shared resources, subtle power dynamics come into focus today. At work, choose strategic patience over impulsive confrontation; an influential ally is watching your composure. In romance, honest vulnerability breaks down a stubborn emotional barrier, allowing a genuine breakthrough with someone you hold dear.
aries.weekly: The energy of early November challenges your natural desire for rapid acceleration, urging you instead to consolidate recent gains. Midweek tests your diplomacy in team environments, particularly where shared finances or joint creative efforts are at stake. By the weekend, a supportive aspect from Mars sharpens your intuitive focus, revealing lucrative paths forward.
aries.monthly: November 2026 plunges you into deep psychological terrain as the Sun travels through Scorpio, illuminating areas of personal transformation and financial regeneration. This month is less about starting new crusades and more about refining existing commitments. As planetary shifts highlight your sector of expansion later this month, prepare for an intellectual awakening that broadens your horizons.

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.daily: Today places interpersonal connections squarely at the center of your universe. Professional collaborations flow effortlessly when you invite differing viewpoints into the discussion rather than clinging to routine. Emotionally, your heart seeks steady ground; offer reassurance to a loved one, and you will receive profound loyalty in return.
taurus.weekly: Your seventh house of partnerships is humming with activity this week, prompting you to evaluate whether your commitments are reciprocal. While mid-week may bring a brief clash over conflicting priorities, staying anchored in your personal values restores balance. An unexpected olive branch or networking proposal arrives before the weekend begins.
taurus.monthly: This November centers on the alchemy of your relationships and legal or contractual alliances. With transformative celestial alignments urging you out of your comfort zone, you will find that flexibility is your greatest superpower. Mid-month invites serious dialogues regarding long-term financial security, leaving you feeling far more grounded by month's end.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.daily: Your daily workflow demands disciplined organization today, Gemini. Clear communication with colleagues prevents minor misunderstandings from mushrooming into larger hurdles. On the emotional front, give your busy mind a breather by engaging in a calming evening routine; a heart-to-heart message will restore your romantic optimism.
gemini.weekly: A fast-paced week requires you to streamline your schedule and safeguard your physical vitality. You may experience tension between professional demands and domestic responsibilities around Thursday, but clear boundaries will save the day. The weekend opens radiant doors for meaningful romantic encounters or joyful intellectual collaborations.
gemini.monthly: November encourages a systemic overhaul of your daily routines, wellness habits, and administrative structures. As the planetary tides shift attention toward your reciprocal partnerships late in the month, clarity replaces recent ambiguity in personal bonds. You are learning to channel your boundless curiosity into tangible, sustainable everyday habits.

cancer.name: Cancer
cancer.daily: Inspiration arrives like a gentle tidal wave today, stoking your creative embers and expressive flair. At work, your intuitive instincts about people give you an undeniable edge in presentations and negotiations. Love holds sweet resonance this evening; let your defensive shell fall away to embrace sincere warmth and affection.
cancer.weekly: The cosmos infuses your week with heightened creative passion and playful self-expression, lifting your spirits. Watch for minor misunderstandings regarding creative ownership or romantic expectations around midweek, which dissolve quickly through compassion. By Sunday, you will feel deeply replenished and ready to tackle pending professional duties.
cancer.monthly: November is a deeply fruitful month for your inner artist and your inner child, Cancer. The cosmos highlights joyful self-expression, romance, and recreational pleasures, counterbalancing the heavier obligations you have carried this autumn. As the month draws to a close, a grounding transit turns your attention toward purposeful work and vibrant well-being.

leo.name: Leo
leo.daily: Your attention turns inward toward your private sanctuary and domestic roots today. Professional matters still require a steady hand, but prioritizing emotional safety over workplace theatrics yields the best outcome. In romance, creating a cozy, intimate environment helps you and your partner reconnect on a soulful frequency.
leo.weekly: This week asks you to balance family or household responsibilities with rising ambitions in the public sphere. You may feel pulled between the needs of loved ones and urgent career deadlines on Wednesday, requiring graceful boundary-setting. As the weekend arrives, your warmth and charisma rekindle, drawing supportive friends to your side.
leo.monthly: November invites you to explore the foundation of your personal security and ancestral patterns. Major celestial shifts urge you to build an emotionally resilient home base from which your outer success can naturally blossom. The final third of the month sparks a tremendous surge in creative confidence, reigniting romantic fireworks and artistic vision.

virgo.name: Virgo
virgo.daily: Your analytical mind operates at peak efficiency today, making it an ideal time to draft proposals, analyze data, or resolve intricate dilemmas. Be mindful of delivering feedback with kindness rather than clinical bluntness. In matters of the heart, an inquisitive conversation reveals an enchanting, unexpected side of someone close to you.
virgo.weekly: Communication is your central arena this week, filled with contracts, short trips, and vibrant discussions. Watch out for information overload around Thursday, when conflicting signals could lead to unnecessary second-guessing. By Saturday, an intuitive breakthrough resolves a persistent puzzle, freeing your schedule for restorative leisure.
virgo.monthly: November activates your cognitive sphere, sharpening your skills, networking prowess, and communicative influence. The cosmic weather supports writing, teaching, or mastering a sophisticated craft that solidifies your expertise. As the month winds down, your focus naturally pivots to domestic harmony and strengthening ties with family roots.

libra.name: Libra
libra.daily: Financial assessment and self-worth take center stage today as the planetary current urges practical realism. A workplace proposal deserves your discerning eye; ensure the financial compensation matches your true effort. In romance, shared values and unspoken mutual trust speak far louder than grand gestures right now.
libra.weekly: Your primary mission this week is anchoring your material world while aligning it with your spiritual values. Midweek prompts a careful audit of your expenses or contractual terms, presenting a valuable lesson in financial sovereignty. The weekend brings a delightful mental refresh, ideal for social gatherings or an inspiring cultural excursion.
libra.monthly: The cosmic spotlight shines brightly on your resources, earning power, and core values throughout November. It is a period for establishing profound financial confidence and eliminating self-sabotaging doubts about your deservingness. By late November, an intellectual awakening inspires you to express your ideas with newfound clarity and conviction.

scorpio.name: Scorpio
scorpio.daily: With the cosmic spotlight glowing upon you, personal magnetic pull is at an all-time high today. Career initiatives gain traction as decision-makers respond favorably to your quiet yet unmistakable authority. Emotionally, your intuition is razor-sharp; trust your first impression regarding a romantic overture or private dilemma.
scorpio.weekly: You stand in your full sovereignty this week, though heightened sensitivity might make you prone to guarding yourself too fiercely. Midweek offers a powerful chance to release an obsolete grievance that has tethered your energy to the past. The weekend welcomes profound personal regeneration and the emergence of an exciting opportunity.
scorpio.monthly: This is your annual personal renaissance, Scorpio, a month marked by profound identity upgrades and personal breakthroughs. The Sun traversing your sign magnifies your vitality, magnetic appeal, and ability to manifest deep-seated ambitions. As the planetary tides shift into your finance sector toward the month's conclusion, your focus turns toward building enduring prosperity.

sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
sagittarius.daily: Subtle, reflective energy envelopes you today, making solitude far more productive than crowded conference rooms. Keep your professional cards close to your chest while quietly developing your next big strategy. In romance, allowing space for peaceful contemplation helps you understand what your heart truly desires.
sagittarius.weekly: This week operates as a spiritual incubation chamber for you, encouraging rest and the closure of lingering karmic cycles. While external demands may feel somewhat sluggish or delayed midweek, understand that the universe is protecting your energy. By Sunday, a subtle shift in the air signals that your season of renewal is just around the corner.
sagittarius.monthly: November serves as an inward pilgrimage, inviting you to tie up loose ends, release outdated dreams, and cultivate inner peace. Before the cosmic dawn of your solar season late in the month, prioritize spiritual hygiene and intentional introspection. When the Sun enters Sagittarius later this month, you will step onto the stage completely revitalized and sovereign.

capricorn.name: Capricorn
capricorn.daily: Collaborative energy surges today, making your leadership indispensable within group projects or community organizations. A visionary colleague offers an innovative concept that aligns neatly with your pragmatic standards. In your personal life, friendship and romance happily blur, providing comforting reassurance and shared laughter.
capricorn.weekly: Your network is your greatest asset this week, though you may need to mediate a dispute between divergent personalities around Wednesday. Keeping your classic diplomatic composure will elevate your status among peers and leadership alike. The weekend encourages you to step back from the grind and enjoy soulful connection with your closest confidants.
capricorn.monthly: November invites you to envision your long-term legacy and build alliances that sustain your loftiest aspirations. Group endeavors, humanitarian projects, and long-term networking are strongly favored under the prevailing cosmic conditions. Toward the end of November, you will feel a welcome call to quiet retreat, setting the stage for deep winter renewal.

aquarius.name: Aquarius
aquarius.daily: Career matters demand your full intellectual presence today, as your unique visionary perspective catches the eye of superiors. Avoid cutting corners; meticulous preparation elevates your reputation and cements your standing. Emotionally, take time to celebrate your public triumphs with the partner or friends who tirelessly champion your journey.
aquarius.weekly: Professional milestones are within reach this week, though competing priorities at home may create brief tension on Thursday. Keep your eyes on the horizon and address private duties with efficiency and poise. By the weekend, celebration and vibrant networking restore your spirit, opening doors to influential future alliances.
aquarius.monthly: November places your career, status, and worldly contributions under a bright celestial magnifying glass. This is a potent month to step boldly into authority, present revolutionary concepts, and claim the recognition you have diligently earned. As the month concludes, your social circle widens, bringing eccentric and empowering new allies into your orbit.

pisces.name: Pisces
pisces.daily: A thirst for broader philosophical understanding shapes your mindset today, urging you to explore new horizons. At work, stepping outside established precedent leads to a stunning creative breakthrough that impresses your peers. Love flourishes through shared ideals and deep, mind-expanding dialogues that touch the realm of the sacred.
pisces.weekly: The planetary tides encourage you to expand your world this week through academic pursuits, legal triumphs, or long-distance plans. Midweek may require you to clarify beliefs or travel itineraries, but your natural intuition steers you around any snags. The weekend offers remarkable spiritual clarity and a deep, harmonious connection with your loved ones.
pisces.monthly: November expands your perspective on what is possible, dissolving previous self-imposed limitations and doubts. Major planetary activations in your ninth house of higher wisdom inspire you to learn, travel, publish, or deepen your philosophical foundation. By the final week of November, your focus shifts toward professional ascension, putting your expanded wisdom directly into prestigious action.
